title: Small steps: The spill is not the child
categoryContext: Early years and first school transitions
stageSummary: Describe events, effort and impact without turning a moment into a permanent judgement.
possibleWeather: Young children may hear a pressured sentence as a message about who they are. Keep the language short, concrete and close to the next action.
boundary: The mess still needs to be cleaned.
practice: describe what happened and begin the clean-up
principle: Separate responsibility for an event from a judgement about identity.
nextSentence: The mess still needs to be cleaned. First, describe what happened and begin the clean-up.
keyLearning: Separate responsibility for an event from a judgement about identity.
